subject: Logic 13 track selection: rail AXSelectedChildren is acknowledged without effect, the main Mixer AXSelectedChildren moves the selection
question: On Logic 13 which Accessibility write actually changes the selected track, and does moving the selection by it also let mute, solo and rename act on a non-selected track?

reverify.command: With Logic 13 running a disposable copy of a four-track project with the Mixer visible and track 3 selected, call logic_tracks select with index 0 and read the track-header rows' AXSelected with a separate Accessibility reader; then call mute, solo and rename on that track.
reverify.expected: select returns State A verified, the reader shows only row 0 selected, and mute, solo and rename each return State A verified with the header showing the change. Before the fix select returned State B readback_mismatch with the selection unchanged.
reverify.cost: A disposable project copy; no save.

method: Measured the unfixed product (main at 213035c2) for 3 trials from a fresh copy of the qualification fixture: the select envelope, the operation trace and an independent structural read of every header row. Then, on a fresh copy per probe, wrote or pressed each candidate (rail AXSelectedChildren, row AXSelected, row AXPress, focus radio AXPress, main Mixer AXSelectedChildren) and read the selection at 0, 0.1, 0.4, 0.5 and 1.0 s. Then ran the fixed product for 3 trials.

observations.what: row AXPress and focus radio AXPress
main Mixer AXSelectedChildren written with the strip carrying the track name

conclusion: The rail setter is acknowledged with return code 0 and does nothing on this host; the main Mixer's AXSelectedChildren moves the selection. selectTrackViaAX now requires the exclusive selection to settle and otherwise writes the Mixer strip matched to the header by the track's own name, judged by the header read-back. Mute and rename needed that selection and are resolved by it.
limits: One Logic 13.0 build 7801 host, ko-KR only, one four-track fixture, Mixer visible.
Hidden Mixer, Track Stacks and duplicate track names were not measured live; duplicate names refuse by design and are unit-tested.
The evidence files are retained under the author's cache and are not committed.

canon_not_applicable.reason: This record measures runtime Accessibility write effects on track selection. It adds no Apple label vocabulary and claims no string-corpus value.
